Categories: IP, RISC-V, SiFive

Daniel is joined by David Kravitz, Senior Principal Engineer at SiFive, the pioneer of the RISC- V computing revolution. A veteran silicon architect with decades of experience designing high-performance processors ranging from VAX and Alpha to MIPS and ARM, David led the team behind some of the most critical breakthroughs in modern processor design. He is the co-inventor on several patents powering the SiFive Smart Flow™ technology inside SiFive’s Performance family of products, as recently featured in their Technology Explainer video series.
His pioneering work on hardware-level Dependency Chaining and specialized Transfer Buffers solves one of the biggest challenges in computing today: eliminating data traffic jams between traditional processing and heavy-lifting AI vector workloads. By rewriting the rules of out-of-order execution, these architectural advancements allow next-generation chips to deliver massive, server-class AI performance in a tiny, ultra-efficient physical footprint.
Dan explores the details of the SiFive Smart Flow technology with David, who explains how SiFive’s unique scalar and vector processing come together to create an efficient way of managing out-of-order execution challenges for complex systems. David explains the details behind SiFive’s approach and how it delivers the best system performance. You can learn more about SiFive’s broad capabilities here.
